انتحروا (form VIII)
# اِنْتَحَرُوا (intaḥarū) /in.ta.ħa.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِنْتَحَرَ (intaḥara)
# اُنْتُحِرُوا (untuḥirū) /un.tu.ħi.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِنْتَحَرَ (intaḥara)
# اِنْتَحِرُوا (intaḥirū) /in.ta.ħi.ruː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِنْتَحَرَ (intaḥara)
